definitions.explanation: To free from danger or harm.

examples.japanese: {溺|おぼ}れている{人|ひと}を{救|すく}った。
{困|こま}っている{人|ひと}を{救|すく}う。
{貧|まず}しい{子供|こども}たちを{救|すく}いたい。
examples.english: I want to help poor children.

examples.japanese: {飢|う}えに{苦|くる}しむ{人々|ひとびと}を{救|すく}う{活動|かつどう}。
examples.english: Activities to help people suffering from hunger.

notes:
{救|すく}う means to save or rescue someone from danger, harm, or difficulty.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Pattern: [person/thing]を{救|すく}う

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {命|いのち}を{救|すく}う: to save a life
- {溺|おぼ}れている{人|ひと}を{救|すく}う: to rescue a drowning person
- {世界|せかい}を{救|すく}う: to save the world
- {危機|きき}から{救|すく}う: to save from a crisis

PASSIVE FORM:
{救|すく}われる is commonly used: {彼|かれ}に{救|すく}われた (I was saved by him).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {救|すく}う: to save/rescue (from danger)
- {助|たす}ける: to help (broader, more general assistance)
- {救助|きゅうじょ}する: to rescue (often formal/emergency contexts)

RELATED NOUNS:
- {救|すく}い: salvation, relief
- {救世主|きゅうせいしゅ}: savior
